papers.title_en: SIMQ: A Single Graph-based Index for Multi-Vector Query
papers.authors: Yifan Lu, Jiabao Jin, Xiaoyao Zhong, Peng Cheng, Xiangyu Wang, Haotian Li, Hua Chen, Junqing Chen, Wei Xi, Heng Tao Shen
papers.evidence: 面向多向量近似检索的单图索引，采用逐token图导航
papers.tldr: 多向量检索如ColBERT效果强，但MaxSim计算昂贵且大规模语料扩展受限；现有中心交互矩阵需每查询计算全矩阵并依赖GPU，数据无关压缩召回不稳。SIMQ用数据感知采样聚类组织全部token向量，在簇质心上构建单一图索引，并以逐token图搜索近似MaxSim，避开交互矩阵和GPU加速。理论分析显示数据感知划分的期望近似误差更小；五个基准上比较召回、吞吐与构建时间，主要面向CPU，SIMQ+用计数评分和动态候选集增强稳健性。该框架已集成VSAG，为多向量检索提供可扩展的单图索引方案。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-vector retrieval models such as ColBERT achieve state-of-the-art effectiveness by representing documents as sets of token-level vectors and scoring via MaxSim, but their high computational cost limits scalability to large corpora. Existing approximate methods face fundamental bottlenecks: centroid interaction matrix approaches require computing a full matrix at every query and rely on GPU-accelerated clustering, while data-oblivious compression methods yield unstable recall that requires repeated compensation. We propose SIMQ (Single graph Index for Multi-vector Query), a framework that bridges single-vector graph indices and multi-vector retrieval through data-aware sampling-based clustering and per-token graph navigation, simultaneously bypassing all aforementioned bottlenecks. SIMQ organizes all token vectors into fine-grained clusters via data-aware sampling, builds a single graph index over cluster centroids independently of PLAID's residual representation, and approximates the MaxSim score through per-token graph search without materializing any interaction matrix or relying on GPU acceleration. We provide theoretical analysis showing that, under a manifold assumption and successful cell retrieval, data-aware partitioning has a smaller expected approximation error than a data-oblivious partition. Building on this foundation, SIMQ+ further introduces count-based scoring and a dynamic candidate set to improve robustness across varying query conditions. Experiments on five benchmarks compare recall, throughput, and construction time against several baselines, primarily on CPU; large-scale PLAID k-means centroids are built on a separate GPU machine. SIMQ has been integrated into VSAG, an Ant Group's open-source vector search library.

papers.title_en: Pelorus: Warped-Product Graph Indexing for Hyperbolic Vector Search
papers.evidence: 面向双曲近似最近邻搜索的扭曲积邻近图索引
papers.tldr: 双曲嵌入适合层次数据，但百万规模ANN需平衡测地保真与内存效率，平坦内积索引跨径向壳层失真，原生双曲图访问全精度或量化共形尺度不佳。Pelorus提出翘曲乘积近邻图索引，分离FP32径向/共形标量与2比特球面方向码，延迟FP64重排，并用共形失真分析指导去偏、切锥残差和Jacobian门控，QuadriPrune分配多类边。Cohere-1M建索引快5.44倍，热导航内存517MB，99% Recall@10下单线程/24线程吞吐提升4.30/6.31倍，MERU-1M达53,483 QPS。聚类窄壳召回从34.22%升至99.385%，为双曲向量检索提供高内存效率索引。
papers.abstract_en: Hyperbolic embeddings capture hierarchical relations, but million-scale approximate nearest neighbor search must reconcile geodesic fidelity with memory efficiency. Flat inner-product indices distort order across radial shells, while native hyperbolic graphs repeatedly access full-precision vectors or quantize coordinates with singular conformal scales. We present Pelorus, a warped-product proximity-graph index for hyperbolic vector search. Pelorus separates unquantized FP32 radial and conformal scalars from scale-invariant 2-bit spherical directional codes and defers full-vector FP64 evaluation to a compact reranking tail. A conformal distortion analysis motivates orthogonal-projection debiasing, purity-gated tangent-cone residuals, and Conformal Jacobian gating. QuadriPrune allocates edges across geodesic fibers, same-shell rings, and radial elevators, with spanning-tree chord swaps restoring entry reachability. A single-page record layout and carry-save AVX2 kernel accelerate traversal. Across eight real and synthetic benchmarks on AMD EPYC 9654, Pelorus builds Cohere-1M indices 5.44x faster than full-precision polar graphs on 32 threads, reducing hot navigation memory to 517.0 MB. At 99% Recall@10, it improves Cohere-1M throughput by 4.30x on one thread and 6.31x on 24 threads, and delivers 53,483 QPS on MERU-1M. On clustered narrow shells, tangent-cone residuals raise recall from 34.22% to 99.385%, while isotropic narrow-shell stress tests expose remaining recall limits.

papers.title_en: RAG in a Trenchcoat: When Minimal Memory Is Enough for Agentic Systems, and When It Isn't
papers.authors: Jingyu Liu, Zongze Li, Zach Xu, Zhanhui Zhou, Tahseen Rabbani, Dawn Song, Ce Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向智能体系统的最小RAG记忆，采用BM25与余弦混合检索并在记忆基准上评估
papers.tldr: 现有智能体记忆不断堆叠抽取、反思、更新与图合成等模块，但其成本收益缺乏系统检验。作者提出极简RAG记忆BRIDGE，采用链式观察笔记、BM25与余弦混合检索及时间顺序渲染，每次写入或查询仅调用一次大模型。它在LongMemEval-S和BEAM上与先前最优方法置信区间内持平，在EverMemBench上领先5.7至6.3点；五类对抗探针却显示没有架构能通吃。论文据此主张，记忆评估应从“检索到什么”转向“使智能体能做什么”。
papers.abstract_en: Agentic memory research has accumulated extraction, supersession, reflection, and graph synthesis on top of retrieval-augmented generation. However, we found that almost none of those primitives earn their cost in our tested memory benchmarks: we show this with BRIDGE, a deliberately minimal RAG memory with chained observation notes, hybrid BM25 with cosine retrieval, and chronological rendering, which reaches parity within bootstrap CI with the prior SOTA on LongMemEval-S and BEAM, and beats the best memory baseline on EverMemBench by 5.7-6.3 points at matched reader. It runs at ~5-7K reader-prompt tokens per query, using a single LLM call for each ingestion or query. We argue that this parity is itself the result: standard benchmarks score what memory retrieves, not what memory enables when the agent acts. To test the latter, we introduce five adversarial probes (Rule Application +-, Pattern Induction Style / Procedural, Dynamic Multiturn) judged at generation time by a cross vendor verification chain, where each query can only be solved by applying a remembered rule or pattern it never mentions. Across 5 probes x 20 scenarios, no architecture wins universally: atomic fact extractors (LangMem) win rule application, while BRIDGE's block-summary memory wins pattern induction. This result holds across four domains, three graders, and three reader families. Each design fails where the other wins, for reasons a recall benchmark cannot see: atomic-fact extractors discard the form a demonstrated pattern takes, while block-summary memory retrieves the rule but the reader does not act on it, a gap that presenting the rule more prominently largely closes. What separates memory designs is not what they retrieve but what they enable an agent to do, and that is what agentic memory should be evaluated on.

papers.title_en: EvoDisco: Strategy Discovery for Evolving Agent Memory
papers.authors: Mingyang Liu, Qingcan Kang, Shixiong Kai, Kaichao Liang, Xiaojin Fu, Tao Zhong, Linqi Song
papers.evidence: 面向自主LLM智能体的记忆机制与演化
papers.tldr: 大型语言模型智能体在交互中持续积累经验，记忆如何随时间演化与记忆内容同样关键；但现有在线更新方法仍把变换算子及其选择规则固定下来。EvoDisco把智能体记忆演化表述为进化策略发现，让可学习策略根据当前记忆状态和近期任务历史，选择并实例化摘要、精炼、桥接与重构四类语义算子，并以双层适应度更新策略。在ALFWorld、WebShop和LifelongAgentBench上，该方法优于MemP与MemRL，ALFWorld在线与冻结迁移分别较MemP提升8.8和12.9点，较MemRL提升16.4和17.9点。消融显示双层适应度与算子库均有贡献，工作将记忆更新从静态调度推进为可学习的策略发现问题。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents accumulate experience in memory, and how that memory evolves during interaction is as important as what it stores. Recent methods update memory online, yet both the operators that transform memory and the rules that select them remain fixed by design. We propose EvoDisco, which formulates agent memory evolution as evolutionary strategy discovery: the agent must discover which operator to apply, when to apply it, and how to instantiate it, rather than rewriting memory under a static operator schedule. A learnable policy conditions on the current memory state and recent task history, then selects and instantiates one of four semantic operators---Abstract, Refine, Bridge, and Reframe---which respectively compress related memories, decompose overloaded entries, connect weakly linked experiences, and reorganize retrieved reasoning chains. The policy is updated with a bi-level fitness. An inner signal scores each transformation using a retrieval-quality improvement regularized by memory complexity. An outer signal scores strategic efficacy over a window of past decisions, combining historical operator-utility regret, utility-prediction error, and selection diversity. Under a one-pass online plus frozen-transfer protocol on ALFWorld, WebShop, and LifelongAgentBench (OS and DB), EvoDisco improves over strong memory baselines including MemP and MemRL. The largest gains are on ALFWorld ($+8.8$ online / $+12.9$ frozen-transfer points over MemP; $+16.4$ / $+17.9$ over MemRL). Ablations attribute these gains to both fitness levels and the operator library.

papers.title_en: Reliable Evaluation of AI Agents for Investment Research: A Framework for Performance and Validity Assessment
papers.authors: Dongnuan Tian, Yan Yu, Yangfan Liu, Wenjun Tang, Junting Kan, Xiang Wang, Sicong Liu, Yangyang Zhang, Shuanghong Li
papers.evidence: 面向投资研究任务的AI智能体性能与评估有效性框架
papers.tldr: AI 智能体在投资研究中需调用外部信息与计算工具产出报告，但最终输出质量未必反映执行过程质量，评估程序本身的有效性也影响结论可信度。为此，作者提出面向领域的评估框架，将结果质量与执行质量分离，并以任务特定准则、确定性校验器和独立大模型评审适配不同任务需求。框架还引入评估有效性机制，检查评估输入、参考信息、支撑证据与评分输出的完整性，并用专家复核处置缺陷与重大评分分歧。实验显示该框架能区分智能体在不同维度上的表现差异，并识别评估过程中的可靠性隐患。
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of evaluating AI agents undertaking investment-research tasks, where agents interact with external information sources and computational tools to produce financial analyses and research reports. An important challenge is that the quality of an agent's final output does not necessarily reflect the quality of its execution process, while the reliability of the resulting assessment also depends on the validity of the evaluation procedure. Furthermore, investment-research tasks differ considerably in their requirements for numerical accuracy, information retrieval, financial analysis and supporting evidence, making it difficult to assess agent performance using a uniform set of criteria. We propose a domain-oriented evaluation framework that distinguishes outcome quality from execution quality and accommodates these differences through task-specific criteria, deterministic validators and independent large language model judges. We also introduce an evaluation-validity mechanism that examines the integrity of evaluation inputs, reference information, supporting evidence and grading outputs, with expert review used to resolve identified deficiencies and significant grading disagreements. Numerical results show that the proposed framework can distinguish differences in agent performance across evaluation dimensions, while identifying potential reliability issues in the evaluation process. The associated implementation and evaluation materials will be made available on GitHub.

papers.title_en: SkillBuffBench: Measuring What Agent Skills Contribute across Harnesses, Models, Skill Access Modes and Memory
papers.authors: Gengyue Dong, Ye Wei, Zheng Zhu, Yidong Han, Jiale Miao, Xiaojun Jia, Guanghui Li
papers.evidence: 跨框架、模型与记忆设置的智能体技能评测基准与配对评估协议
papers.tldr: Agent Skills 已被各大 agent harness 内置，但现有收益证据多来自人工指定正确 Skill、agent 从空白起步的理想设置，与真实部署不符。作者提出 SkillBuffBench：把 Skill 访问设为三级因子（无 Skill、精选 Skill、从已安装库自动调用），交叉记忆开关、四种 harness 与多家模型，在材料科学与生物学专家任务上用确定性验证器配对评测，并以配对 bootstrap 报告不确定性、单列成本与耗时。论文当前仅给出基准设计、评测协议与任务/Skill 清单，评测仍在进行，结果将滚动更新。
papers.abstract_en: Agent Skills, file-based packages of procedural knowledge that a coding agent can discover and load on demand, are now shipped by every major agent harness, yet the evidence for how much they help comes almost entirely from settings in which the right Skill is hand-picked for the task and the agent starts from a blank slate. Neither holds in deployment, where an agent chooses from whatever library happens to be installed and frequently carries memory from earlier work. We present SkillBuffBench, a benchmark and paired evaluation protocol that treats Skill access as a three-level factor (no Skill, a curated Skill, and automatic invocation from an installed library), crosses it with memory (off and on), with four agent harnesses and with multiple models (the state-of-the-art proprietary models from Anthropic, Google and OpenAI, and the state-of-the-art open-weight models from Chinese providers), every model being run under every harness, and evaluates the result on research tasks contributed by domain experts together with the Skills they use, currently in materials science and biology, with the suite extended on a rolling basis. Every run is marked by a deterministic verifier; uncertainty is reported with a paired, task-level bootstrap; and cost, agent rounds and wall-clock time are reported alongside the score rather than folded into it. This version of the paper describes the design of the benchmark, its evaluation protocol and its current tasks and Skills. The evaluation is in progress: results will be added once the runs are complete, and the task suite, results and analysis will continue to be updated on a rolling basis.

papers.title_en: Beyond Episodic Recall: Experience-to-Knowledge Evolution for Lifelong Embodied Navigation
papers.authors: Weitao An, Chenghao Xu, Xu Yang, Cheng Deng
papers.evidence: 面向具身智能体、将经验演化为知识的两时间尺度记忆框架
papers.tldr: 终身具身导航需持续积累并复用经验，但现有记忆存储成本高且难将经验演化为环境知识。EvoNav提出双时间尺度记忆框架，将语义观测、空间关系与任务反馈组织为稀疏经验原子，在线巩固观测并建立动态链接，慢尺度蒸馏类别共现与反馈为环境结构知识。新目标搜索时融合原子证据与结构知识，在可通行地图上引导导航。多场景实验显示其以紧凑持久记忆提升路径效率，并成功迁移到真实机器人。
papers.abstract_en: Lifelong embodied navigation requires agents to accumulate experience through continuous interaction and reuse it for subsequent goal searches. Existing memory-enhanced methods typically retain historical observations or construct structured scene representations. However, storing observations or high-dimensional semantic embeddings incurs growing storage costs. Meanwhile, structured representations support retrieval and semantic reasoning but do not explicitly evolve accumulated experience into environment-specific knowledge. To address these limitations, we propose Experience-Evolving Memory (EvoNav), a novel two-timescale memory framework. It organizes semantic observations, spatial relations, and task-feedback cues into sparse experience atoms. During online operation, experience atoms continually consolidate repeated observations and form dynamic links based on transitions. At the slower timescale, EvoNav distills accumulated category co-occurrences and feedback signals into environment-specific structural knowledge without relying on predefined object--room relations. For each new goal, EvoNav combines direct goal evidence from experience atoms with learned structural knowledge to guide goal-directed search on the current traversability map. Experiments on single-goal, sequential multi-floor, and multimodal navigation demonstrate effective experience reuse and improved path efficiency with compact persistent memory, together with successful transfer to a real robot.

papers.title_en: LMMR: Learned Multigranular Memory Retrieval for Small Language Model Agents
papers.authors: Pengfeng Song, Yunkai Zhuang, Liye Shi
papers.evidence: 面向语言模型智能体的多粒度记忆检索
papers.tldr: 小语言模型代理在多跳问答中记忆读取空间有限，相关事实分散且周边文本占用预算。LMMR学习多粒度记忆检索，同时选择下一来源与读取粒度，训练时关联段落和句片段并利用干扰与重复信息构造对比。推理时重排器评估候选对锚点段落的补充，选择器在token预算内选证据。在三个多跳数据集上，冻结2B模型于400 token预算下取得61.47、43.26、30.58 F1，优于查询扩展并减少记忆输入23.1-26.9%。
papers.abstract_en: Small language model agents have limited space to read the memory needed for multi-hop questions. Relevant facts are often scattered across records whose surrounding text consumes much of that space. We propose LMMR, a learned multigranular memory retrieval method that selects both the next source and how much of it to read. LMMR links paragraphs and sentence fragments to their original sources and pairs views that supply the same missing support during training. Relevant distractors and repeated information provide contrasting examples. At inference, the reranker scores what each candidate adds to an anchor passage, and a selector chooses the evidence within a token budget. On 22,398 official validation questions from HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, and MuSiQue, a frozen 2B answer model reaches 61.47, 43.26, and 30.58 F1 under a 400-token budget. The gains over query expansion are 3.06, 2.14, and 4.55 points, while memory input decreases by 23.1-26.9%. LMMR also uses 23.5-27.7% fewer input tokens than a coarse retriever trained on the same questions. Against that retriever followed by LLMLingua-2 at comparable input lengths, F1 gains reach 3.99 points and are significant on HotpotQA and 2WikiMultihopQA after Holm correction. All eight small answer models evaluated on HotpotQA improve over query expansion and MMR in both F1 and exact match.

papers.title_en: Errpedia: Is Your Exact $k$-NN Vector Search Really Exact?
papers.authors: Yinuo Deng, Ying Zhang, Hanchen Wang, Wenjie Zhang
papers.evidence: 检验向量数据库精确 k 近邻搜索的数值正确性
papers.tldr: 精确 k-NN 向量搜索被广泛用作精确结果来源和近似搜索的评测基准，但浮点舍入与溢出可能让“精确”搜索返回数学上错误的 top-k 结果集，且难以察觉。作者构建 Errpedia 数据集，覆盖 21 类错误、共 1616 条查询，并用精确有理数算术独立验证 ground truth。评测 20 种主流库与数据库配置后发现，每种配置都至少在一条适用查询上返回错误的 top-10 结果，包括近等距向量排序错误、返回邻居数少于 k，甚至有库完全漏掉 10 个精确匹配。该工作提供了可复现的数值正确性基准，暴露了精确向量检索的可靠性隐患。
papers.abstract_en: Exact $k$-nearest-neighbor ($k$-NN) vector search is a common feature of vector libraries and database systems. It serves applications that require exact results and provides the ground truth for evaluating approximate search. However, floating-point rounding and overflow can cause an exact search to return mathematically incorrect top-$k$ result sets. These errors can go unnoticed and affect downstream tasks that rely on exact results. We present Errpedia, a purpose-built dataset for testing the numerical correctness of exact vector search. Errpedia contains 1,616 queries across 21 error categories, with ground truth independently verified using exact rational arithmetic. We evaluate 20 widely used library and database configurations and find that every tested configuration returns mathematically incorrect top-10 result sets on at least 1 applicable query. Failures include misranking nearly equidistant vectors and returning incomplete results: 1 library omits all 10 exact matches to a query, and several systems return fewer than $k$ neighbors. We release Errpedia as a reproducible benchmark for developers and researchers to test their implementations. The dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/dynos01/errpedia.

papers.title_en: RegimeCouncil: Paired-Evidence Routing For Memory Conflict Governance In LLM Agents
papers.authors: Qingcan Kang, Mingyang Liu, Shixiong Kai, Tao Zhong, Mingxuan Yuan
papers.evidence: 面向大模型智能体长期记忆的记忆冲突治理
papers.tldr: LLM代理的长期记忆会随世界变化而过时，延迟反馈下负反馈应只抑制同一事实还是跨事实传播，现有系统在设计时固定范围。RegimeCouncil用有无记忆的配对比较作证据，设Local Advisor与Global Advisor，并由Meta Governor在线仲裁且不重训LLM。在LongMemEval及TempLAMA/TAQA、Qwen3-30B-A3B与GPT-4o上，主要分歧事件超最佳固定策略5.2-7.3点，30个留出设置全胜。其贡献是将记忆冲突治理形式化为在线范围选择，并给出延迟反馈下的有限时间切换保证。
papers.abstract_en: Language agents rely on long-term memory to personalize responses across extended interactions, yet stored facts quietly go stale as the world changes, and an agent often learns that using memory hurt only through delayed feedback after acting on an outdated record. Before the memory store is updated, how far should that negative feedback propagate: should it suppress memory use only on future queries for that same fact (a local policy), or also across other stored facts (a global policy)? Existing memory systems implicitly fix one of these two sharing scopes at design time. We formulate this online scope choice under hidden validity and delayed feedback as memory conflict governance, and prove that neither fixed policy is sufficient on its own. We then propose RegimeCouncil, a lightweight paired-evidence router that retains both scopes as advisors and arbitrates between them online without retraining the LLM. Using revealed comparisons between answering with memory and answering without memory (the no-memory anchor), a Local Advisor tracks the latest outcome on the queried fact alone, while a Global Advisor pools recent outcomes across all stored facts. A Meta Governor follows the Local Advisor by default to avoid cross-fact interference and switches to the Global Advisor only when global pooling accumulates a strictly positive recent utility margin, guaranteeing finite-time switching under delayed feedback. Across LongMemEval update streams and real-world historical drift on TempLAMA and TAQA with Qwen3-30B-A3B and GPT-4o, RegimeCouncil outperforms the better fixed-scope policy by 5.2-7.3 points on primary disagreement episodes and across all 30 held-out settings, while ablations show that removing any of its three modules reduces accuracy by 2-7 points.

papers.title_en: RoboTeam: Benchmarking Vision-Based Multi-Agent Control of Many Robot Arms in Real Time
papers.authors: Changxuan Fan, Zhongwei Xie, Boyi Zhang, Shaoli Hu, Chang Xu, Xiyu Ren, Yufei Li, Qiao Xiao, Huihao Jing, Kawai Chung, Wenbin Hu, Hongyu Luo, Lingyun Xie, Yisen Gao, Chunyang Li, Haoyu Huang, Wuganjing Song, Yuxuan Liu, Chiu Yeung Tang, Fangneng Zhan, Xi Yang
papers.evidence: 面向多模态智能体实时控制多机械臂的仿真评测基准
papers.tldr: 现有机器人臂智能体评测多局限于少量机械臂、短任务、可暂停世界或真值物体位置。RoboTeam 构建实时仿真基准，让智能体仅凭相机图像控制4至16条机械臂，完成36个长时程协作任务。在自适应系统中，gpt-6.1-sol与opus-5.5分别完成28和27项，其余四个模型至多3项；典型任务耗时3.5小时、消耗2.18亿输入token。该基准还系统比较单智能体、分层与去中心化系统，揭示速度、成本与可靠性难以兼得。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal agents can now control robot arms by calling tools and writing code. Existing benchmarks fall short in three ways: most test one or two arms on short tasks, many pause the world while the agent thinks, and many give it ground-truth object positions. We present RoboTeam, a simulated benchmark where agents control 4 to 16 robot arms in real time from camera images alone. Its 36 tasks are long jobs that the arms must do together, such as passing timbers or building a picture from hundreds of cubes. We start from the most flexible agent system, the adaptive system, where one agent decides when to fork delegates. With it, gpt-6.1-sol and opus-5.5 complete 28 and 27 tasks, and four other models at most 3. But at a high price: a typical task takes gpt-6.1-sol 3.5 hours and 218 million input tokens, and a third of its steps fail at least once and must be retried. We then compare it with three fixed systems: single-agent, hierarchical, and decentralized. All four complete a similar number of tasks but differ in time and tokens. The hierarchical and decentralized systems are faster but use up to 1.9 times the tokens, and the single agent uses fewer tokens but takes 1.6 times as long, so the adaptive system lies between them. Even so, no model or system is yet fast, cheap, and reliable at once. RoboTeam measures these limits where earlier benchmarks cannot: long multi-arm jobs, camera images only, and a world that never pauses.

papers.title_en: Multi-Agent Memory Inconsistency: Where Factual Conflicts Disappear in LLM Agents
papers.authors: Hejia Zhang, Zhongming Yu, Yimin Ding, Wei-Ting Chen, Hengjia Yu, Wentao Ni, Yijun Liu, Cong Xu, Xin Chen, Matrix Yao, Fan Zhao, Jishen Zhao
papers.evidence: 提出多智能体记忆不一致性基准与证据流分析器
papers.tldr: 多智能体委派让不同子代理分别收集证据，但事实冲突可能在汇交主代理时丢失，造成记忆不一致。作者构建基于 Harvey LAB 文档审查任务的基准与证据流分析器，用受控冲突追踪证据在子代理与主代理间的传递。汇总三个模型发现，委派虽把冲突主张检索率从50.2%提升至68.7%，冲突检测率却从16.2%降至13.2%，且子代理仅35.2%的检索冲突对同时上报。该工作将子代理到主代理的交接定位为改进冲突检测的关键目标。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent delegation lets LLM systems distribute evidence collection across workers with separate contexts. This creates a consistency challenge: facts retrieved by workers may be missing from the evidence available to the lead for a joint conclusion. We introduce a benchmark and evidence-flow profiler for studying multi-agent memory inconsistency through controlled factual conflicts in Harvey LAB document-review tasks. Pooled across three models with comparable generation spending, requiring delegation increases retrieval of both conflicting claims from 50.2% to 68.7% relative to single-agent execution, yet conflict detection falls from 16.2% to 13.2%. Within this setting, workers report both claims for only 35.2% of retrieved pairs, and pooled matched comparisons show higher detection than single-agent execution when one worker reads both claims but lower detection when the claims are split across workers. Worker-to-lead handoffs are a central target for improving conflict detection in multi-agent LLMs.

papers.title_en: From Relevance to Utility: Rubric Alignment in Yuanbao Search
papers.authors: Yu Lu, Lixin Zou, Yangqi Chen, Hui Xu, Qiaolin Xia, Hao Wang, Qianwen Ma, Reed Li, Shuang Zeng, Haijin Liang, Haibo Shi
papers.evidence: 面向下游大模型推理的智能体搜索对齐
papers.tldr: 面向智能体搜索，现有检索仍以单文档相关性排序为主，难以组装适合下游大模型推理的文档集合。论文提出 rubric 对齐搜索，用从粗到细的评分标准统一检索、排序与选择全流程。方法将评分标准蒸馏为文档效用标签，并用集合级奖励驱动双分支强化学习选择器。在元宝搜索上线后，端到端答案质量较线上基线提升 8.52%，把相关性目标推进到推理效用目标。
papers.abstract_en: Agentic search demands that a search engine move beyond per document relevance ranking to assemble document sets optimized for downstream LLM reasoning. Prior work addresses this either by improving individual pipeline stages in isolation or by applying RL based selection on top of relevance trained upstream modules, leaving the full stack unaligned to utility for reasoning. We propose rubric aligned search, a framework that unifies the traditional search pipeline under a single supervision surface. For each query, we derive a rubric from coarse to fine, specifying weighted positive criteria that the document set must satisfy and negative criteria that it must avoid. From this rubric we derive two training signals. First, a lightweight labeler distills rubric grounded judgments into per document utility labels, which supervise a contrastive dual encoder for retrieval and a multi task ranker trained with four rubric aligned scoring heads. Second, a rubric conditioned evaluator produces a set level reward that drives a dual branch RL selector, combining GRPO with best rollout distillation to resolve credit assignment in subset optimization. Deployed in Yuanbao Search, the pipeline improves end to end answer quality by 8.52% over the online production baseline.

papers.authors: Markus Dücker, Vaibhav Kumar, Yi Liu, Ronak Chaudhary, Andreas Plesner, Francisco Guzmán, Anish Athalye
papers.evidence: 针对评分标准评分智能体环境的验证器系统研究与元评测数据集
papers.tldr: 针对评分细则（rubric）判分的智能体环境，输出验证困难且缺乏系统评估。作者构建BVB基准，含24个投行任务、2464条人工判定评分细则，并从细则语料提炼九类能力与三项设计原则，实现开源验证器Gandalf。在BVB上Gandalf以更低成本匹配或超越三个基线，F1达0.864并优于GPT-5.4基线0.12以上，还迁移到OpenClaw取得0.955最高F1。该工作提供基准、方法与开源工具，推动智能体验证标准化。
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents take on increasingly open-ended and complex tasks, verifying their outputs has proven to be difficult. Rubric-graded agent environments, where a verifier judges multiple natural-language criteria against the deliverables and environment state changes produced by the agent, have emerged as a popular paradigm. We conduct the first systematic study of verifiers for rubric-graded agent environments. First, we create BankerVerifierBench (BVB), a meta-evaluation dataset of 2,464 human-judged rubric criteria across 24 investment-banking tasks. Next, we develop a methodology that derives from any rubric corpus the capabilities a verifier should possess, yielding a nine-capability taxonomy that we distill into three general design principles---reactive verification, environment alignment, and domain guidance---which we implement in Gandalf, an open-source verifier. Finally, we evaluate Gandalf against three existing verifiers on BVB. Gandalf matches or exceeds every baseline's F1 at lower cost: with Gemini 3 Flash it matches the strongest baseline's F1 (0.864 vs. 0.852) at one-fifth of its cost, and with GPT-5.4 models it improves F1 by over 0.12 at lower cost. Gandalf also generalizes to OpenClaw, a structurally different personal-productivity environment, where it again achieves the highest F1 (0.955 vs. 0.934 for the best baseline). We release BVB, Gandalf, and the code and data to reproduce our experiments.
